authorization: User continued V27; routine P2A implementation/CPU validation already authorized.
scope: One disabled sensor-only V3 candidate, fixed artificial measurements and finite timing. No World/Node/task-asset load/episode/ENV.step/policy/actor/reward replay/native/GPU.

rules_fixed_before_comparison.reuse: Unchanged V2 input validation, strict source scan identity, bounded per-cell/per-scan scores, integer/rint ray traversal, maximum nohit and workspace checks.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.scores: hit+2/free-1, clip[-4,4], occupied>=2/free<=-2, otherwise unknown; not probabilities.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.closed_endpoint: Every coordinate within four lattice ULPs of integer k has alternatives k-1 and k, including a zero ray component; other coordinates use floor. Cartesian product is 1/2/4 raw cells, before map clipping.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.unique_hit: Only a raw single-cell measured hit adds occupied evidence. Map clipping cannot turn ambiguity into a unique vote.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.ambiguous_hit: Adds no occupied evidence to any alternative. Historical positive evidence is retained, not strengthened.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.within_scan: All current measured-hit alternatives are removed from free votes. A unique hit in another beam can still supply its own one occupied vote in a shared cell. Beam order is irrelevant.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.persistent_hit_veto: After votes, reset negative evidence at every in-map current hit alternative to zero. At least unknown persists until new free evidence, not just a one-frame display mask.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.limits: Closed endpoints resolve numerical membership ambiguity only, not Gaussian range/encoder uncertainty. No inferred thickness, truth normal, occupied dilation, extra direction history or spatial noise band.
rules_fixed_before_comparison.storage: Same persistent score and latest payload as V2; endpoint-support array is temporary and cleared after integrate.

fixed_comparison: Reuse all 14 V27 case definitions and exact scan inputs; add off-grid new-hit persistence after an unobserving scan, identical-input opposite-side tangent truths, rotated single-axis vertex tangency, map-boundary raw ambiguity, numerical ties and mixed-vote permutations. Compare v1/v2/v3 without selecting favorable cases.
structural_checks: Current measured-hit alternatives never output free after an accepted scan.
No new occupied evidence from an ambiguous hit, even after repetitions or map clipping.
Negative evidence reset persists during an unrelated later scan.
Ordinary non-tie hits can become occupied; ordinary free rays establish free after two new votes; saturated ghost can clear after genuine new free scans.
Duplicates, changed/old IDs, invalid inputs, same-cell new scans, maximum nohit, output copies, bounded memory/workspace and ray-order independence remain explicit.
interpretation: Structural consistency checks are not task gates. All-gridline surfaces may remain unknown, losing the V2 occupied recall. Report this cost and persistent-bias counterexamples, original full quality metrics and unknown/free coverage. Do not automatically promote a structurally passing model to behavior readiness.
decision: Evaluate exactly this rule set. If fixed-case costs do not justify a behavior trial, retain it disabled and stop this round's endpoint-only candidate search. Do not produce V4/V5 or sweep thresholds to improve exposed results. Implementation defects can be corrected with preserved failed CPU attempts.
timing: 48x48, at most 360 rays x12 calls/model/mode/round, three alternating rounds; duplicate and new-source same-geometry modes. Integrate-only CPU costs, not ENV throughput/RSS.
